headline: St. Mary's put ten past Sul Ross State
dek: St. Mary's had scored three goals in their first three matches and lost two of them. Sul Ross State have now lost all four of theirs, and their keeper Fernando Hernandez has made twenty-six saves without a clean sheet.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ten different players have scored Midwestern State's nineteen goals, and Jose Ortiz has six of them.

wire.line: Sul Ross State have conceded twenty-one goals in four matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, and UT Dallas's at Ouachita Baptist.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Midwestern State have won four and drawn two, and have conceded six goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won four, drawn one and lost one, and their twelve goals are more than St. Edward's and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Texas A&M International have won three and drawn one, and have conceded three goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Tyler have won two and drawn two, and have conceded four goals.

last_match.line: St. Mary's have not lost since August; Rogers State had beaten Oklahoma Christian at home earlier in the week.

next_match.line: Oklahoma Christian have not won since Newman; Southern Nazarene have already beaten West Texas A&M and lost at Midwestern State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
